notes: No demonstrable errors found. The Romance in B-flat major, Op. 10; Sonatina in D minor, Op. 27; and Violin Sonata in D major are distinct Fibich violin works. They are not duplicates of the Kubelík arrangement of Poème from Op. 41. Their levels sit sensibly: Sonatina L2 < Poème L3 < Romance L4 < Sonata L5.
